get.description:
What the engine has loaded: the Quran and hadith counts and the engine's fingerprint. The first call
starts the engine worker, which takes a few seconds.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api Corpora Sources Get

delete.description:
Forget a prepared source and its cached download (the engine goes back to the built-in hadiths if it
was the one in use). Prepare it again to download it afresh.

post.description: For when the download is blocked: upload the release zip by hand; the source is prepared from it.

get.description:
Corpus units (ayat, hadiths, adhkar, custom quotes) whose reference or text contains `q`. An empty `q`
lists the first units. The first call starts the engine worker, which takes a few seconds.

schema.title: Response Search Corpus Api Corpus Search Get

patch.description: Change the engine choice, the Qira'ah or the adhkar switch used by the next detection.
